deadline.value: Apply by January 10 (11:59 pm Eastern) for Fall admission.
deadline.quote: must be submitted to the Graduate School by January 10 (11:59 pm Eastern Time) for fall admission consideration

gre_general.value: GRE General scores are strongly recommended but not required.
gre_general.quote: The GRE general exam scores are strongly recommended, but not required.

gre_subject.value: The GRE Mathematics Subject test is not required for the Statistics PhD.
gre_subject.quote: It is not required for applicants to the Ph.D. in Statistics or the M.S. programs in Applied Mathematics or Statistics.

supervisor.value: No supervisor is needed to apply; students choose a dissertation advisor after finishing the exam requirements.
supervisor.quote: Choose an official dissertation advisor (and notify the GPM about the choice) within one year after the completion of all exam requirements, or the start of the sixth semester, whichever comes last.

funding.value: All admitted PhD students are offered funding, mostly teaching assistantships with a tuition waiver and stipend.
funding.quote: All admitted PhD students in the department are offered funding.

entry_route.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: Statistics is a separate program from Mathematics within the same department. Biostatistics is offered separately through public health.
